assumptions: Lossless primary n1.5 air/glass/air; radiance support<=1 for conditional power envelope. Source-video camera/display response and reflected environment are NOT known. Ceiling applies ONLY if all reflected+transmitted color then goes through same bounded encoded gain/bias and frost filter. It is not automatically the correct material role.
derivation: q=sqrt(1-(n^2-1)s^2). Rs=((n-q)/(n+q))^2 increases; Rp=((1-nq)/(1+nq))^2 decreases for0<=s<=M<1/n. Hence R_unpol<=(Rs(M)+Rp(0))/2; all nonprimary power<=Rfront+(1-Rfront)*Rbound, regardless further paths. No extra normal or source field.
blockers: O1 zero-height crease classification remains uncorrected; no path continuation performed.
Frozen source is only scrolling background plane. Front reflected environment and many secondary terminations have no independently supported RGB.

Frosted transmitted-color response and specular reflection may need distinct grade/PSF roles; implementing that is shared material-interface work, not an independently painted rim. No role extension adopted.
claim_limits: Conditional bound/material ceiling only, NOT a complete Apple radiance model or global impossibility. Unobserved HDR, camera transfer, external lighting and a different actual surface remain outside it. Saved target reads are statistics, not new source samples or scoring-mask change.
